title: How many childhoods defined by streets where we stomped our feet? Even in our suburban corner I find that ties that bind cast you as a foreigner only
summary: How many childhoods defined by streets where we stomped our feet? Even in our suburban corner I find that ties that bind cast you as a foreigner only the Broadview crew knew what to do and who was who #smallpoems #Microblogvember
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
How many childhoods defined
by streets where we stomped our feet?
Even in our suburban corner
I find that ties that bind
cast you as a foreigner
only the Broadview crew
knew what to do and who
was who
#smallpoems
#Microblogvember
